# Author-approved Q1–Q16 manuscript — paper-v1.0

Source-only model selection and limits of fixed spectral-sharing pipelines in cross-subject motor-imagery EEG decoding

Ziyuan Zhu, College of Artificial Intelligence Medicine, Chongqing Medical University. Correspondence: zzy2630816871@gmail.com. Postal address: Jinyun Campus, No. 61 Daxuecheng Middle Road, Shapingba District, Chongqing 401331, China.

The author confirmed final main/supplement/figure review and approval, sole authorship, personal checking and revision, institutional wording, data-term checks, GitHub-only public manuscript history and no other-journal consideration. Journal of Neural Engineering is the target; this repository release does not submit the paper to the journal.

The acknowledgement identifies ChatGPT (GPT-6, as reported by the author) for information retrieval, grammar revision and GitHub publication assistance. Actual OpenAI Codex research/code/figure/verification/drafting assistance remains disclosed. Historical model identity and human review are not presented as independently observed facts.

Frozen Q1–Q16 scientific content is unchanged: no fits, model selection, checkpoint inference or raw physiology processing was performed for this update. All 16,417 protected scientific files retain their hashes. Q15 original source fits=15, migration new source fits=0 and target fits=0; Q16 remains descriptive and BNCI-only with no causal decoder mechanism or external physiological replication.

Validation: 628 delivery checks, 179 current review-input bindings, 422 saved-number checks covering 261 display cells, 34 independent author/editorial checks and independent submission-package/layout review. The main PDF has 26 pages; combined manuscript 33; supplement 18. The clean JNE submission ZIP contains 28 payload files plus a manifest. Raw EEG and credentials are excluded.

Immutable manuscript artifact commit: `4b7629bd0b04c7778175f490efcf0f2574a65fc5`. The publication readback receipt is a separate later commit to avoid circular verification. The earlier paper-v1.0-rc1 release and historical receipts remain intact.

body:
# Language-refined Q1–Q16 manuscript — paper-v1.0.2

Source-only model selection and limits of fixed spectral-sharing pipelines in cross-subject motor-imagery EEG decoding

Ziyuan Zhu, College of Artificial Intelligence Medicine, Chongqing Medical University. Correspondence: zzy2630816871@gmail.com.

This release corrects two review-file bindings after a final layout-report update. Manuscript, supplementary, cover and JNE submission files are byte-identical to the preceding paper-v1.0.1 artifact; frozen scientific results and the 28 references are unchanged. The full evidence/reproducibility ZIP is rebuilt to bind the current review reports. Historical tags are not moved.

This candidate foregrounds three empirical contributions: source-only selection diagnostics, the separation between aggregate gains and participant-level benefit, and frozen external evaluations that retain adverse and uncertain outcomes. Class-recall tradeoffs and the separation of computational verification, acquisition assumptions and descriptive sensor physiology support those contributions. The paper introduces no new decoding algorithm or first/SOTA, cohort-interaction, equivalence, clinical or mechanistic claim.

The revision edits 112 manuscript prose/caption/note fields and 25 companion passages, removes repeated/template-like phrasing, clarifies inference units and conditional uncertainty, standardizes ordinary narrative spelling and repairs literal Markdown italics markers in expanded supplementary exports. Frozen tables, quantitative figure files, equations, all 28 references and all 16,417 protected scientific files retain their hashes. No fits, model selection, checkpoint inference, raw EEG processing or new statistical outputs were performed.

The preceding scientific candidate was approved by the author. **The new wording requires an author read before actual JNE submission.** This prerelease does not invent new approval, submit to the journal, mint a DOI or claim acceptance. The prior stable paper-v1.0 remains intact.

Real AI assistance remains disclosed: ChatGPT GPT-6 is author-reported, and actual OpenAI Codex literature/code/verification/figure/drafting assistance remains described. Historical runtime identity and human verification are not reconstructed or fabricated.

Current validation: 680 delivery checks, 230 exact review-input bindings, 422 saved-number checks for 261 display cells, 783 edit-integrity checks, 40 independent scientific-language checks and 35 independent submission-package checks. PDF pages: main 26, combined 33, supplementary 18, cover 2. JNE ZIP has 28 payload files plus its manifest. Raw EEG, checkpoints and credentials are excluded from publication bundles.

Audited manuscript candidate for **Journal of Neural Engineering** author preparation; not a journal submission or acceptance.

**Source-only model selection and limits of fixed spectral-sharing pipelines in cross-subject motor-imagery EEG decoding**

Author: Ziyuan Zhu (朱子元), College of Artificial Intelligence Medicine, Chongqing Medical University.

Immutable manuscript/result snapshot: `49499b111d84ffd3b49ed3323b2816069403dc93`. Scientific Q1–Q16 outputs, full-precision tables, p-values, intervals, selected epochs and numerical figures are unchanged. This release makes editorial, citation, workflow-label and layout revisions only. Q16 is BNCI-only, descriptive, sensor-level and post-decoder-outcome; external physiological replication and decoder mechanism are not established. Adverse/null results are retained.

The current revision passed **599 final-delivery checks**, **422 saved-evidence numeric checks** covering **261 displayed numeric cells**, and **47 independent editorial checks**. Hashes of **16,417 protected scientific files** remain unchanged. The linked publication receipt identifies individual GitHub artifact SHA-256 and byte-length readback. No new fits, raw EEG analysis, checkpoint inference or parameter selection was performed for this revision. Q15 original source fits remain 15; target fits remain 0.

Files: separate main manuscript PDF/DOCX; combined manuscript Markdown/TeX/PDF/DOCX; supplementary PDF/DOCX; bibliography; reproduction guide; all figures, tables and validation evidence in the complete ZIP; manifest/checksum and remote-readback receipt. PDFs are verified ReportLab exports. Native TeX compiler handlers were unavailable, so native TeX compilation is **unverified**.

Institution English wording is supported by published affiliations; a current official university English naming page was not established. Funding/conflicts/secondary-analysis ethics requirements reflect the author's confirmation; no committee determination or identifier is invented. Archive licensing needs author confirmation before a Zenodo deposit.

No raw EEG or credentials are included. Original data must be obtained from BNCI, PhysioNet and the Cho2017/Lee2019 provider records under their terms. No archive DOI has been minted. Earlier branches and experiments remain intact.
